value.rationale: The well-known Kneser boundary KG(6,2) has known minimum forcing number but an unclassified multiplicity and solution-geometry in the inspected literature. This result gives a complete seven-orbit object classification, exact minimum-set count, and an unexpectedly connected, nonregular self-centered reconfiguration graph with full distance distribution. These data are a natural reproducible benchmark for solution reconfiguration at a significant first triangle-containing member of KG(n,2); neither scalar Z=10 nor generic definitions imply them.
